description: Seeded-error set for the Verifier (spec section 13). Each item is a script sentence, the sentence before it, and a quote locating the chunk the Writer would cite. Errors are seeded by hand: changed numbers, names, or relations; over-generalisation; facts that are true in the world but absent from the materials; misleading framing.

items.quote: Most evaporation happens over the oceans
items.text: Most evaporation takes place over the oceans, since they cover most of the Earth's surface.
Cold water evaporates faster than warm water.
Plants give off water vapour through tiny openings in their leaves, and this is called transpiration.
Those tiny openings in the leaves are called stomata.
Rising moist air expands and cools, and cooler air holds less water vapour.
As moist air rises, it is compressed and warms up.
The vapour condenses into tiny droplets around specks such as dust or salt.
Hail forms only in thunderstorms with strong updrafts.
Whether it falls as rain, snow, sleet, or hail depends on the temperature of the air on the way down.
